summary: Iteration 74 admin new-user registration notification: all 12 requested behaviours verified via new pytest suite tests/test_admin_registration_notify.py (14 tests) plus regression on test_resend_from_address.py (6), test_support_contact.py (6), test_admin_support_inbox.py (19). 45/45 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 7481 lines — should be split into modules (auth, email, admin, stripe, sessions) for maintainability. Not blocking but growing risk.

_derive_plan_label uses ISO-string comparison against datetime.now().isoformat() to check 'future' — string-lexicographic comparison of ISO-8601 timestamps works but only if both are UTC (with same trailing +00:00 shape). Users seeded with a naive/timezone-differing pro_until could produce wrong labels. Consider parsing to datetime and comparing objects. Currently OK for the register-time path since fresh users have neither flag set.

_notify_admin_registration falls back to datetime.now(UTC) if created_at parsing fails — silent behaviour. Since the register endpoint always stamps created_at with isoformat() this is safe today but the fallback masks bugs. A logger.debug on the except would help future forensics.
seed_data_creation: Each register test creates a TEST_-prefixed user and cleans it up via pymongo in a finally block. Rate-limit test cleans up all TEST_rl_* users too.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 74 verified. Subject string 'New User Registration - Solarisound' is exact. Admin notify fires only on 200-registration path; duplicate (400), Pydantic validation (422), and rate-limited (429) branches all skip it (verified via unittest.mock.patch). Legacy digest helpers (_queue_admin_signup_alert, _flush_admin_signup_digest, _notify_admin_new_user, _admin_signup_buffer) all confirmed absent from server.py via grep test. RESEND_ADMIN_RECIPIENT / RESEND_API_KEY empty branches confirmed silent no-op. HTML injection escaped. Welcome-email regression still fires (both tasks queued per success).
